stratagems.name: Reanimation Protocols
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has had any models destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each destroyed model: on a 5+, return one destroyed model to your unit with its full complement of wounds.

stratagems.name: Disruption Fields
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: Quantum Shielding
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Damage characteristic of that attack is 3 or more, that attack has a Damage characteristic of 1 instead.

stratagems.name: Hypercrypt Node
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it in Reserves. At the start of your next Reinforcements step, set it up anywhere more than 9" from all enemy models.
